'''Military tactics''' is a [[military]] [[skill]]. Along with [[leader]] and [[organizer]] skills, it affects [[mission]] simulations on the world map, giving the side with the better tactician a greater chance of victory.

Military tactics of the squad leader determines a [[squad]]'s success chance in pillage and raze [[mission]] battles. The skill skews rolls in battles in opposition to the opponent's tactician skills. A successful pillaging mission where the squad gains a {{DFtext|positional advantage}} over the enemy gives 500 [[experience]] points towards the tactician skill of the [[militia captain]].

Military tactics is an available skill at [[embark]]. When assigning squad members, military tactician appears as a relevant skill for squad-leading nobles/appointments.
